children: may retest a support at $4,257 per ounce, a break below which could trigger a drop toward $4,197.
A wave C from $4,512 may either end around its 61.8% projection level of $4,257 or extend to the 100% projection level of $4,099.
Given the preceding wave A adopted a five-wave mode and the wave B reversed less than 61.8% of the wave A, the current wave C may extend toward $4,099.
The tricky part is how and when the metal breaks $4,257, as it is experiencing a bounce. It is not clear how strong the bounce is.

A falling channel indicates a target of $4,354. A weak bounce, however, may end around $4,317. Strategically, a break below $4,284 would indicate a completion of the bounce. A break above $4,317 may lead to a gain to $4,354.
On the daily chart, the metal has briefly pierced below the support at $4,306 again. It is highly likely to break this level and fall toward $4,168.
